label: non-GO steps after an unrewarded trial when value is low (late episode)
explanation: Never active at GO, active on D1 and D2 about equally. 87% of activation mass falls on trials whose D1 showed no reward (prev_reward == 0; in_rew == 1 almost never). Firing is strongly tied to the model's low value estimate (the bottom value sextile holds 47% of mass; it never fires when value > 8.1) and rises steeply late in the episode (trials 90-99 hold 46% of mass; it never fires before trial 10). Secondary biases: D2 after an a1 choice / S2 input, prev trial rare, good=S1. The largest activations come in runs of unrewarded trials (often a1 into S2 rare). Predicate: non-GO step, previous trial unrewarded, value < 7.13. Uses only observed variables plus the model's own value. Dev F1 0.46, mass recall 0.72; the top quartile of activations is 95% covered but weak activations are scattered, and precision is only ~0.38. The unit looks like a graded low-value / recent-non-reward signal more than a crisp event detector.
